name: rooms-webapp

dependencies.name: rooms-api
dependencies.description: Searches rooms, creates and cancels bookings, and lists the signed-in member's own bookings.

description: The single-page app every Member uses: browse the room catalog, search for a free room by time range and group size, book one, and manage their own upcoming bookings. Holds no business data itself — every read and write goes through rooms-api. Does not expose any admin or room-management screen.
